verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server that lets developers use natural language with an LLM client to connect to Adyen's platform and build payment solutions faster, which is the closest evidence to natural-language operation, but it's framed as a general developer/platform tool rather than natural-language control specifically of in-person/POS payment operations (refunds, tipping, terminal management, etc.). missing for 10: evidence that in-person/POS-specific actions (issuing refunds, managing terminals, tipping) can be driven via natural language commands, and independent confirmation of the MCP server working in practice for POS use cases.
